sections.critical_distinction: Florida and Arizona publish grade-level standards. IB is a programme framework, not a grade-by-grade checklist. IB grade placement here is our convention (PYP K-5, MYP 6-10, DP/CP 11-12) and is Label C unless an official IB source says otherwise.

trust_rules: Treat only status reviewed or approved as ready for learners; drafted is for internal use.
Use label A and B content for factual claims about what a standard or framework requires.
Always show label C content as suggestion. Never present it as official.
Preserve standard ids exactly when storing mastery against standards.

sections.purpose: A research-backed, version-controlled library comparing Florida standards, Arizona standards and IB frameworks for Kindergarten through Grade 12 in ELA, mathematics, science and social studies. It feeds the AI Learning Primer.
quality_rules: Official sources only: fldoe.org, cdn.fldoe.org, cpalms.org, azed.gov, ibo.org.
Record URL, title, version date, page and access date for every source.
Never reconstruct restricted IB content from memory.
Never claim Florida and Arizona standards are equivalent because the wording is similar.
Flag standards that do not map cleanly.
Every document carries its own citations.
Instructional bridges are practical but always Label C.
No PDF or Word output until the JSON is reviewed.
